Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of the roadway in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle began to drift into the
adjacent right lane to change lanes. Driver 2 was operating a vehicle in the right lane and was unable to avoid
contact, resulting in a sideswipe collision between the passenger side of Driver 1's vehicle and the driver side of
Driver 2's vehicle. Responding officers confirmed that a Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the
impact, and the Passenger reported pain to the shoulder. Both drivers stated that the vehicles separated shortly after
contact and came to rest along the shoulder. Damage visible on both vehicles is consistent with the described angle
and force of the impact, and no prior damage was observed or reported on either vehicle. Photographs taken at the
scene document several of the reported details. No independent witnesses were located, so the account relies on the
statements of the drivers and the physical evidence at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as an insured operator on the
policy covering the vehicle. The shoulder injury descrbied is a plausible result of a collision of this type.
